title: Task DSL contract v1 — FROZEN at M1
description: A guided task, authored as data in assets/tasks/*.json. The step engine is generic over this file from M1, so adding a task in M3 is a drop-in file with zero code change.

title.description: Human title, shown on the overlay card.

utterances.description: Example phrasings that start this task. Used for the deterministic keyword fallback when the planner is unavailable — NOT the primary matcher.

resource_id.description: Bare view id (without package prefix) to locate on screen, e.g. amount_field.

instruction.description: Spoken aloud verbatim. Keep it one short sentence.

expects_value.description: True when this step collects a value the user speaks. Drives M2 self-correction (last stated value wins).
